name: Disrupt the Attacks

meta.next: Supplies for the Crossroads, The Disruption Ends

summary: Thork needs the Crossroads defended as Razormane quilboar cut its supply roads. Their ambushes have halted caravans from Durotar, and the outpost is running short on food and gear. You strike at the quilboar while scouts search for the one directing their warband.

sections.title: A Severed Lifeline
sections.body: The Crossroads guards a key junction for Horde traffic through central Kalimdor. Freight wagons and caravans bring food, iron, and equipment west from Durotar, and the outpost depends on those supplies. Razormane ambushes along the northeast trails have stopped the deliveries. Stores are running low, and Thork cannot wait for peaceful talks.

sections.title: Pruning the Brambles
sections.body: Thork sends you against the quilboar bramble dens northeast of the settlement before they can assault the town walls. Striking their Water Seekers, Thornweavers, and Hunters weakens the Razormane scouting perimeter and deprives raiding parties of magical and logistical support. These skirmishes buy time while Horde trackers search the brush for the one organizing the raids.

faq.q: Why are the Razormane raiding caravans?
faq.answer: The Razormane see the Barrens as their ancestral homeland. They regard the Crossroads and Horde caravans crossing their hunting grounds as intolerable trespasses, so they ambush the supply wagons.

Thork is an orc commander stationed at the Crossroads. He oversees the outpost's daily defense, coordinates scouts, and sends warriors to secure trade roads from hostile centaur, harpies, and quilboar.
The Razormane encampments lie east and northeast of the Crossroads, along the foot of the mountains separating the Barrens from Durotar. Towering briar vines surround their camps.

faq.q: What comes after disrupting their attacks?
aliases: next quest after disrupt the attacks
faq.answer: After the first force is driven back and scouts identify who commands the raiders, Thork immediately sends you after their chieftain in The Disruption Ends.

faq.q: What role do Water Seekers play in the tribe?
faq.answer: Water is the Barrens' rarest and most prized resource. Water Seekers find wells, oases, and hidden underground springs to supply the tribe and its war parties.
Thornweavers are quilboar geomancers and spellcasters who shape earth and grow the massive, impenetrable briars guarding their dens. In battle, they wield the region's nature magic against intruders.

angles.text: The route between Durotar and the Crossroads is the Horde's main supply artery in central Kalimdor. If the quilboar close it, the whole outpost risks going hungry.
As an orc settling Durotar, you need room to expand into the Barrens. The quilboar's relentless ambushes stand in your way and must be met with force.
Taking down Razormane Hunters in the scrub tests your tracking against native skirmishers who know the terrain intimately.
